defs.def: to bring back a situation or feeling that existed before 恢复（某种情况或感受）

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。
错误会导致学习中的困惑。

ex.s: restore old workshops              B. understand the craftsmen
ex.t: 恢复旧作坊              B. 了解工匠

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: Lin Feng: Our job is to protect and restore the natural environment.
ex.t: 林峰：我们的工作是保护和恢复自然环境。

ex.s: Local officials were concerned that the pollution was damaging the natural environment and felt that urgent steps should be taken to restore the river’s original beauty.
ex.t: 当地官员担心污染正在破坏自然环境，认为应该采取紧急措施恢复河流原有的美丽。

ex.s: Today, more than people have had their eyesight restored, thanks to the work of the foundation.
ex.t: 今天，多亏了该基金会的工作，已有超过 人恢复了视力。

defs.def: to bring sb/sth back to a former condition, place or position 使复原；使复位；使复职
to repair a building, work of art, piece of furniture, etc. so that it looks as good as it did originally 修复；整修；使复原

ex.s: Help restore and protect Marin's natural areas from the Marin Headlands to Bolinas Ridge.
ex.t: 帮助修复并保护从马林海角到博利纳斯岭的马林自然区域。

ex.s: Even if every clock in the Palace Museum were restored, there would still be work to do, because restoration would probably need to begin again on the clocks that were repaired long ago.
ex.t: 即使故宫博物院里的每一座钟都被修复了，仍然有工作要做，因为很久以前修复过的钟很可能又需要重新开始修复了。

defs.def: to bring a law, tradition, way of working, etc. back into use 重新采用（或实施）；恢复

ex.s: Soon we may be able to use such treatments to restore a blind person's vision or give someone who was born deaf an excellent sense of hearing.
ex.t: 很快我们或许能够利用这类治疗方法恢复盲人的视力，或让天生耳聋的人拥有出色的听力。

defs.def: to give sth that was lost or stolen back to sb 归还（失物、赃款等）

chunks.cn: 恢复 该 自然的
